days.title: AI Fundamentals & Python Setup
objectives: Set up Python development environment with virtual environments
Understand core AI/ML concepts: supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement learning
Run a basic OpenAI API call and parse JSON responses

days.title: OpenAI API Deep Dive
objectives: Authenticate and use the OpenAI Chat Completions API
Understand role-based message formatting (system, user, assistant)
Handle API errors, rate limits, and token usage

days.title: Prompt Engineering Basics
objectives: Write effective zero-shot and few-shot prompts
Apply chain-of-thought reasoning techniques
Evaluate prompt quality with systematic testing

days.title: LangChain Introduction
objectives: Understand LangChain's core abstractions: Chains, Runnables, LLMs
Build a basic LCEL pipeline from prompt to output parser
Connect LangChain to OpenAI and Anthropic backends

days.title: Memory & Conversation History
objectives: Implement stateful multi-turn conversations with message history
Compare buffer, summary, and window memory strategies
Persist conversation state across server restarts

days.title: Document Loaders & Chunking Strategies
objectives: Load PDFs, HTML, and Markdown documents programmatically
Apply recursive and semantic chunking strategies
Evaluate chunk size trade-offs for retrieval accuracy

days.title: Embeddings Explained
objectives: Convert text to high-dimensional vector embeddings using Sentence Transformers
Understand cosine similarity and Euclidean distance metrics
Visualize embedding clusters using PCA dimensionality reduction
Compare local vs. cloud embedding model trade-offs for latency and accuracy

days.title: Vector Databases Overview
objectives: Understand vector indexing strategies: HNSW, IVF, Flat
Persist and query vector embeddings using ChromaDB locally
Compare cloud-hosted (Pinecone) vs. self-hosted (Weaviate) vector databases
Implement metadata filtering and namespace segmentation

days.title: Building Your First RAG Pipeline
objectives: Build an end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline
Connect document ingestion, chunking, embedding, and retrieval
Evaluate RAG output quality using LangChain evaluators

days.title: Retrieval & Matching Engine
objectives: Implement hybrid search combining dense (semantic) and sparse (BM25) retrieval
Build query routing logic to select appropriate retriever based on query type
Apply reranking with cross-encoders to improve retrieval precision
Benchmark retrieval latency and accuracy across different indexing strategies

days.title: Advanced RAG Optimization
objectives: Implement Hypothetical Document Embeddings (HyDE) for better query expansion
Apply multi-query retrieval to broaden document coverage
Measure RAG quality using RAGAs metrics: faithfulness, answer relevancy
Handle out-of-context and hallucination edge cases

days.title: Prompt Engineering Fundamentals
objectives: Master advanced prompt patterns: ReAct, Self-Consistency, Tree-of-Thought
Design prompt templates with Jinja2 for dynamic variable injection
A/B test prompts systematically using PromptLayer analytics
Understand token economics: optimize prompts to reduce API costs

days.title: Function Calling & Tool Use
objectives: Define OpenAI function schemas using JSON Schema or Pydantic models
Implement deterministic tool dispatch patterns with error handling
Chain multiple tool calls in a single conversation turn
Handle partial and parallel function call responses

days.title: Structured Outputs & JSON Mode
objectives: Force strict JSON output using OpenAI's structured output API
Map Pydantic models directly to response_format schemas
Handle parsing errors and validation failures gracefully
Design nested schema hierarchies for complex structured data extraction

days.title: Agentic Loops & ReAct Pattern
objectives: Implement the Reason + Act (ReAct) agentic loop from scratch
Build a custom tool registry with dynamic tool selection
Handle infinite loop prevention and step-count limits
Trace and debug agent reasoning chains

days.title: Chatbot Backend & API Integration
objectives: Build a stateful multi-turn chatbot REST API with FastAPI
Implement session management using in-memory stores or Redis
Integrate external REST APIs and handle authentication headers
Design Pydantic request/response models for strict schema validation

days.title: Streaming Responses
objectives: Implement token-by-token streaming from OpenAI using async generators
Serve streaming responses via FastAPI's StreamingResponse and SSE
Handle client disconnections and stream interruption gracefully
Build a real-time chat UI consuming streamed responses

days.title: Asynchronous Programming for AI
objectives: Understand event loop mechanics and coroutine scheduling
Run multiple LLM API calls concurrently using asyncio.gather
Implement background task queues for long-running AI jobs
Profile async vs. sync performance differences

days.title: AI Security & Guardrails
objectives: Implement prompt injection detection and prevention
Build content safety filters for PII detection and toxicity scoring
Apply role-based access control to AI-powered endpoints
Design graceful fallback responses for blocked content

days.title: Fine-Tuning & Custom Models
objectives: Prepare and format training datasets in JSONL format
Submit and monitor fine-tuning jobs via OpenAI API
Evaluate fine-tuned model performance vs. base model
Apply LoRA adapters for parameter-efficient fine-tuning

days.title: Evaluations & LLM Testing
objectives: Design automated LLM evaluation frameworks
Measure hallucination rate, answer relevancy, and context precision
Build regression test suites to catch model drift
Integrate evaluation pipelines into CI/CD workflows

days.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration
objectives: Design multi-agent systems with supervisor and worker agent roles
Implement inter-agent communication protocols and shared state
Build parallel task execution graphs using LangGraph StateGraph
Handle agent failure recovery and task retry mechanisms

days.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
objectives: Understand the MCP server-client architecture and transport layers
Build a custom MCP server exposing tools, resources, and prompts
Connect an MCP server to Claude Desktop for local tool access
Implement authentication and error handling in MCP tool definitions

days.title: AI Pipelines & Workflow Automation
objectives: Design directed acyclic graph (DAG) pipelines for AI workflows
Trigger AI pipelines from webhooks and scheduled jobs
Implement conditional branching and error retry in pipeline graphs
Monitor pipeline execution with observability dashboards

days.title: Vector Database Production Patterns
objectives: Design multi-tenant vector store architectures with namespace isolation
Implement hybrid metadata + vector filtering at scale
Optimize index parameters for production throughput and recall
Handle data migrations and index schema versioning

days.title: Cost Optimization & Caching
objectives: Implement semantic caching to avoid redundant LLM API calls
Build tiered caching: in-memory → Redis → vector cache
Profile and reduce token consumption using prompt compression
Design A/B strategies for model routing (cheap vs. powerful LLMs)

days.title: Enterprise Architecture Patterns
objectives: Design microservice architectures for AI-powered applications
Implement event-driven patterns with async message queues
Apply CQRS and event sourcing to AI workflow systems
Design database schemas for audit logging and compliance

days.title: Docker & Kubernetes Deployment
objectives: Containerize FastAPI AI applications with multi-stage Dockerfiles
Orchestrate multi-container AI stacks with Docker Compose
Deploy to Kubernetes with resource limits, health checks, and rolling updates
Build CI/CD pipelines with automated Docker build and push workflows

days.title: Monitoring, Logging & Observability
objectives: Instrument FastAPI with Prometheus metrics and custom counters
Build Grafana dashboards for LLM latency, token usage, and error rates
Implement distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry across service boundaries
Set up LLM-specific observability with Langfuse for prompt/response logging

days.title: Scalability & Production Hardening
objectives: Configure Gunicorn with multiple Uvicorn workers for horizontal scaling
Implement load balancing and auto-scaling policies on cloud platforms
Design circuit breakers and bulkhead patterns for AI service resilience
Conduct load testing with Locust to validate throughput targets

days.title: Capstone Project & Final Demo
objectives: Design and build an end-to-end production AI application integrating 5+ cohort modules
Present architecture diagram, tech stack decisions, and performance benchmarks
Deploy the capstone project publicly and document the API reference
Conduct peer code review and present technical learnings to the cohort
